messages:
Sam: Quick one — Cactus Council election! Our office cactus by the north window needs a representative. Nominate + a one-liner please :cactus:
Priya: Nominate Spike — best at faking interest in sunlight. :raised_hands:
Jules: Spike for mayor. Also put a tiny sombrero on it last week, leadership potential. :party-parrot: :sunglasses:
Mia: I nominate Thorn — quieter but sharper takes. :smirk:
Lenny: Can we draft a tiny constitution? Might need a seal (rubber stamp or actual leaf). :wax_seal:
Sam: Poll options (react with :one:/:two:/:three:):
1) Spike
2) Thorn
3) Let it remain anarcho-green
Priya: :one:
Jules: :one:
Mia: :two:
Lenny: :three:
poll-bot: Poll closed — results: Spike 2, Thorn 1, Anarcho-green 1. Spike sworn in as Cactus Council Rep. :cactus: :tada:
Sam: Congrats Spike! Badge coming (tiny paper sombrero). :smile:
